verdict.rationale: Jan documents downloading and running local LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss) from HuggingFace through a llama.cpp backend, plus importing GGUF files and searching the Hub by model ID. That implies broad model coverage, but only LLMs are explicitly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MoE support, multi-modal/vision models, embedding models, evidence of 'hundreds' of supported architectures, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Download and run LLMs (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GPT-oss etc.) from HuggingFace
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
From Local Files: Click Import Model and select your GGUF files.
Enter a model's Hugging Face ID (e.g., `org/model_name_or_id`) in the Hub's search bar.
